Purpose: Detailed execution plan for native production trace capture. This is a PLAN ONLY — no production trace is collected. No LiveCapture execution. The plan defines all parameters needed for future authorized execution.

PlanStatus.ProductionTraceExecutionAllowedReason: Plan is defined and ready, but execution requires explicit authorization (--confirm-live-capture + --capture-token per V16.8 contract) AND the execution endpoint must be implemented beyond the V16.11 skeleton.

WorkspaceCollectionTemplate.Description: Real production workspace ID. Must NOT be synthetic (native-ws, smoke-ws, dryrun-ws, etc.). Must contain real user traffic. Value to be filled at execution time.

CollectionTemplate.Description: Real production collection ID. Must NOT be synthetic.

TokenBudget.Description: Token budget for BuildDetailedAsync. Controls how many items are scored and selected. Same budget used in V16.7 controlled replay.

ExpectedRowCount.Reasoning: V16.4 dry-run produced 49 rows with synthetic seeded stores. V16.7 controlled replay produced 33 rows with FileSystem seeded stores. Production workspace with real data is expected to produce 30-200 trace rows depending on workspace complexity.

RunIdPolicy.Description: Before creating FileRuntimeCandidateTraceSink, check if output path exists. If yes, abort with idempotency error. Each runId must be unique.
RunIdPolicy.RetryPolicy: Never reuse a failed runId. Generate a new unique runId for each retry.

ValidationThresholds.ParseErrorCountDescription: Zero parse errors allowed. Any malformed JSONL line fails validation.
ValidationThresholds.MissingCriticalFieldCountDescription: Zero missing critical fields. Critical fields: operationId, candidateId, sourceType, authority, retrievalChannel, traceSource.
ValidationThresholds.AllRowsTraceSource3Description: Every trace row must have traceSource=3 (PackageTrace). Any row with traceSource != 3 fails validation.
ValidationThresholds.NativeWeightedPairwiseAccThresholdDescri: WeightedPairwiseAcc must be >= 0.55 on combined native trace data. This is the same threshold used for ControlledReplay metric quality in V16.7.
ValidationThresholds.ScoringSelectedCountPositiveDescription: At least one candidate must be selected by scoring (selectedByScoring=true).
ValidationThresholds.ScoringRejectedCountPositiveDescription: At least one candidate must be rejected by scoring (selectedByScoring=false).
ValidationThresholds.PackageIncludedCountPositiveDescription: At least one candidate must be included in the package (includedInPackage=true).
ValidationThresholds.PackageDroppedCountPositiveDescription: At least one candidate must be dropped from the package (includedInPackage=false).

AbortConditions.BuildError: If BasicContextPackageBuilder.BuildDetailedAsync() throws an exception, abort collection immediately. Dispose sink. Restore NullSink. Delete partial trace file.
AbortConditions.IdempotencyViolation: If trace file already exists for runId, abort with RejectExistingRunId error.
AbortConditions.ValidationFailure: If any validation threshold is not met (ParseErrorCount > 0 OR MissingCriticalFieldCount > 0 OR not AllRowsTraceSource3), mark trace as INVALID. Do not count toward metric quality pass.
AbortConditions.MetricQualityFailure: If NativeWeightedPairwiseAcc < 0.55 on traced data, do NOT set NativeProductionTraceReady=true. Do NOT set ProductionGeneralizationReady=true.

RollbackCleanupProcedure.Step1: Call sink.FlushAsync() then sink.Dispose() to flush and release file handle.
RollbackCleanupProcedure.Step4: If collection failed or was aborted, delete the partial .jsonl trace file.
RollbackCleanupProcedure.Step5: If collection succeeded, the trace file is retained as production trace artifact.
RollbackCleanupProcedure.Step6: Log completion status (success/failure/abort) with runId, row count, operationId, timestamp.
RollbackCleanupProcedure.Note: No application state rollback needed — trace collection is diagnostic append-only.
